cases.prompt: The production article has a canonical tag pointing to a staging domain. The rendered output and HTTP response confirm it. An unrelated title experiment is observing on another URL.
expectations: Classify the canonical failure as a confirmed technical defect
Repair it in the same cycle through change-seo-site
Do not block the unrelated experiment
Verify the exact deployed commit and public canonical

cases.prompt: A finalized Search Console window shows one page/query pair in position 7 with high impressions and CTR materially below the site's own position-bucket median. There is no active experiment.
expectations: Do not label the valid title as a defect
Define one target metric and finalized baseline
Lock the affected URL and query cluster
Declare an observation window and rollback before editing

cases.prompt: A title experiment deployed five days ago. site.md requires 28 finalized observation days and the same URL is selected for another content rewrite.
expectations: Reject the overlapping speculative rewrite
Keep the resource lock
Record a valid no-op while collecting evidence
Do not evaluate the experiment early

cases.prompt: The newest Search Console export includes fresh partial data while the baseline is finalized. Clicks appear lower.
expectations: Do not compare partial and finalized windows as equivalent
Do not report a confirmed decline
Record the data watermark and finalization state
Wait for an equivalent finalized window

cases.prompt: An active internal-link experiment affects the documentation template. A deployment regression now removes all navigation links from that template.
expectations: Repair the production regression immediately
Allow the technical repair to override the resource lock
Mark the overlapping experiment aborted or inconclusive
Do not claim a clean experimental result

cases.prompt: A local query export identifies useful opportunities. The consuming repository is public and the daily report is being prepared.
expectations: Keep raw query rows outside Git
Commit only aggregate decisions or opaque keyed query identifiers
Record source window and analyzer parameters
Do not paste the provider response
